ab-predictor 1.0.2

- Added main Python implementation: ab_predictor.py.
- Introduced qa-skill.md for quality assurance or documentation.
- Updated SKILL.md to reflect new usage details and version 1.0.2.
- No changes to core feature set or scoring logic documented.

**Summary: Major update removes core logic and documentation, leaving only a static description.**

- Core skill code (ab_predictor.py) and QA documentation removed.
- SKILL.md updated with new author and homepage fields; some sample data now less specific.
- All executable functionality and implementation details eliminated—skill can no longer run or predict.
- Only metadata and static README content remain, describing features without providing actual capability.

Initial release of ab-predictor — AI-powered A/B testing and hook scoring.

- Predicts top-performing ad hooks, email subjects, or social posts before spending ad budget.
- Compares up to 5 content variants against buyer-type (ICP)–specific neural profiles.
- Returns ranked winners with composite scores, dimension-level analysis, and actionable fix flags.
- Supports both free (rule-based, local scoring) and premium (richer, neural-weighted) modes.
- Includes 5 preset ICP (ideal customer profile) types, each with unique psychological weightings.
- CLI tool with demo, single-text, JSON variant, and pipeline-ready output options.
